companySlogan: Specialized in design and manufacturing SMT THT machine for smart EMS Factory
description: Fast-loading WordPress-compatible single HTML interactive 3D viewer for a Southern Machinery product visual reference.
sourceNotice: Fast interactive 3D visual reference. Product text loads first, then the optimized model opens in staged sections. Final machine fit, dimensions, and commercial specifications are to be confirmed.
rfqIntro: For this product quotation, please provide these details first.

marketingTiles.label: Features
marketingTiles.text: Optimized STEP visual reference, text-first page loading, browser-based 3D controls, and staged Step Mode display.

marketingTiles.label: Advantages
marketingTiles.text: Makes geometry, clearance, layout, and integration discussions easier before engineering confirmation.

marketingTiles.label: Benefits
marketingTiles.text: Reduces early design back-and-forth and helps customers understand the product concept faster, even before the 3D model finishes booting.

marketingTiles.label: Applications
marketingTiles.text: Use this area to explain where the product is used in SMT, THT, board handling, or inspection workflows.

rfqItems.label: Machine model
rfqItems.text: Exact production machine model, head/station, interface, and current part reference if available.

rfqItems.label: Detailed product drawing
rfqItems.text: Dimensioned 2D/3D drawing of the target component, PCB, feeder, fixture, or process part.

rfqItems.label: Samples or photos
rfqItems.text: Clear photos, sample availability, material, weight, packaging direction, and handling condition.

rfqItems.label: Application requirement
rfqItems.text: Target output, process issue, orientation requirement, quality target, and clearance limits.
